name: feature-outcomes
title: Feature outcomes
description: Each feature paired with the result a named customer measured: the feature, what it does and the number it moved.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and eyebrow, items (the feature, an href, a line, the metric as a value and a label, and the customer) and a note. Each row is a ruled line: the feature's name as a link (the whole row is the target), what it does, and on the right a large figure with what was measured and who measured it. The customer is always required, and the note is where you say how the figures were measured and over what period: both are what keep the section honest. Figures use tabular numbers and never wrap, and a word after the number ("11 hrs") is set smaller than the number. A value that starts with a minus or a plus is read out as down or up ("first reply time: down 38%, measured by Northwind"), because a dash is not read as a direction; a hyphen is drawn as a proper minus sign. Under 672px of width each row stacks as feature, description, figure. labels translates up, down and the words read before the customer.
